problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 52 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 70 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
